points.quote: Create the identifier with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')`... It is normally exported under the same name as the interface

You use `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, ...staticArgs)`... Contributions: workbench contributions, editors and similar are created through `createInstance`, so they get injection automatically.
These calls are usually made at module level in `*.contribution.ts` files or in the service's own file.
